purpose: Deterministically materialize, inspect, test, and voluntarily request admission review for detached creation-unit candidates, including hands, capabilities, organs, protocols, skills, specialists, recipes, and openly named extension kinds.

properties.path: detached candidate directory; repo-local paths must stay under creations/
properties.proposal: spawn only; one closed axm.creation-unit-spawn-proposal/v0.1 object with exact text payload, contracts, lineage, tests, limitations, zero authority, and four-root fit
properties.replace: spawn only; optional explicit replacement of an existing detached candidate
properties.readiness_statement: request-admission-check only; caller or candidate explanation for choosing review now
properties.requested_by: request-admission-check only; inspectable human, AI, or candidate identifier

relationships: turns supplied human, AI, recipe, or explicit external designs into detached inspectable candidate bodies
tests capability and hand candidates through their declared disposable candidate tests
validates organ candidates against the installed executable-organ package grammar and runs declared v0.2 fixtures without installing them
keeps materialization, test evidence, admission request, approval, installation, registration, promotion, and merge as separate states
allows new extension kinds without claiming kind-specific runtime verification for them

anatomy_refs.basis: The capability deterministically assembles a bounded multi-file candidate package, emits exact lineage and file digests, validates the staged and published body, and keeps that package detached from the live machine.
Every spawned unit contains a closed typed package manifest and a separate spawn receipt.
Recipe is a supported candidate kind, but recipe activation and a general recipe interpreter remain separate future capabilities.
Specialist overlays can be materialized as typed candidates while remaining explicitly distinct from identity, authority, expertise proof, or independent evidence.

limitations: the forge deterministically materializes supplied designs; it does not claim that the deterministic kernel invented their semantic design
all payload is currently bounded UTF-8 text
capability and hand tests execute only declared candidate fixtures with current process permissions and do not prove general behavior
organ tests validate the executable-organ package contract and run declared v0.2 deterministic fixtures, but do not execute emitted runtime behavior
protocols, skills, specialists, recipes, and extension kinds currently receive structural and declared file checks rather than kind-specific runtime execution
a recipe candidate is not automatically activated as a forge builder
a specialist is only a temporary method overlay and is not an identity, permission grant, proof of expertise, or independent source of evidence
admission requests do not approve, install, register, promote, merge, change CANON, or change permissions
persistent_state: caller-selected detached candidate directories and their current admission-request artifact remain until deliberately removed

truth.basis: Materialization, package integrity, declared tests, runtime evidence strength, missing semantic proof, and admission state remain separate and inspectable.

agency.basis: Humans and AIs can supply radically different unit designs, while no proposal grants itself execution, installation, merge, promotion, CANON, or permission authority.

continuity.basis: New machinery is first created in detached recoverable bodies and does not silently rewrite or replace the live machine.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: The forge reuses one closed admission-neutral pathway for many creation-unit kinds and requires exact evidence before any separately chosen adoption.
